source_recovery: Exclude all 50 source-canonical groups of cardinality>1; restore original source IDs for34550singletons; neverdeconvolve mergedcounts.
Ensembl_source_rule: Strip only terminal numeric version for lookup; preserve full original ID andversion; require one HGNC approvedrecordvalid stableENSG target.
symbol_source_rule: Exact case-sensitive official approvedsymbol first; then official previoussymbol onlyifone approved HGNC record/one stableEnsemblID; no genericalias or capitalization guesses.
duplicate_target_rule: Exclude entire group when multiple source rows map to one target, regardless counts; no sum, max or disease-drivenchoice.
unmapped_rule: Exclude from namedgene countmatrix; preserve sourcecounts and reasons.
universe: HGNC approved namedgeneuniverse, not completeEnsemblgene universe and not networkuniverse.
count_representation: Original fractional estimated UMIs; original lexical decimal values; no rounding, normalization or diseaseeffects.
downstream_network_universe_status: NOT FROZEN: discovery expression filtering and permitted network construction remain future gatedsteps.
